hook: Why do luxury brands think everyone needs to stare into nowhere to sell perfume? Today: fragrance ads, ranked.
outro: Art, or nonsense? Drop it below, and hit subscribe!

items.line: Brad Pitt stares at a wall having an existential crisis. What did we learn? Nothing! Straight to D-Tier, sorry Brad!
Paco Rabanne 1 Million has a guy in a suit doing interpretive robot dance moves at a giant stack of gold bars. Confident? Definitely. Coherent? Not even a little. B-Tier, we're still confused.
A bison in the desert, Johnny Depp behind the wheel. No idea what the perfume smells like, but this is pure charisma. S-Tier, no debate!
